newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian shares rise, turnover falls this week.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian shares rise, turnover falls this week.

text.p: Three corporate issues traded on the Bulgarian stock market this week with two of them rising as interest in some corporate stocks picked up, brokers said.
"Rising demand from brokers and investors pushed up some corporate issues, which have a larger liquidity," said a broker.
TBS Hotels second issue rose to 102 levs, up 27.5 percent from last week but still well below par of 1,000.
Razvitie Investment Fund's (RIF) third issue closed at 35 levs, up 2.94 percent from last week and below par of 100.
Varna Grand Hotel traded at an average of 87 levs against 100 par, unchanged from last week.
Total stock turnover fell to 9,630 levs ($43) from 15,550 levs ($67) the week before and traded volume shrank to 120 shares from 400.
Weekly repo turnover on local bourses retreated to 4.368 million levs from last week's all-time high of 23.619 million levs.
The 13-share Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index (RABSI) closed at 41.28 points, up 0.26 from last Friday, due to the rise of RIF' third issue and TBS Hotels second issue.
* RABSI calculated on daily basis since February 1, 1994 -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
